title: DeepRIoT: Continuous Integration and Deployment of Robotic-IoT Applications
problem: Accelerating the learning and deployment of deep RL-trained robotic-IoT systems while handling the sim-to-real gap and optimizing plant models to adapt controllers to real-world dynamics.
motivation: Robotic-IoT systems require efficient and automated deployment of RL controllers in real environments with practical constraints and cost efficiency.
method: DeepRIoT uses a multi-stage approach: training a multi-objective RL controller in simulation, collecting traces from the real robot to optimize its plant model, applying transfer learning to adapt the controller to the updated model, and automating the entire pipeline through CI/CD systems for streamlined deployment.
key_novelty: Automated CI/CD-driven framework that combines plant model optimization with transfer learning for sim-to-real deployment of robotic RL systems.
contributions: CI/CD architecture for automated training and deployment of robotic-IoT systems
Multi-stage training approach integrating simulator and real robot feedback
Plant model optimization using real robot traces for improved sim-to-real transfer
Transfer learning methodology to adapt RL controllers to updated dynamics

metrics.accuracy: Successfully reaches goals and avoids collisions

primary_theme: Automated CI/CD deployment of RL-trained robotic systems
